entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Le Locle–Les Brenets line is a 1,000 mm railway line in the canton of Neuchâtel in Switzerland. It runs 4.1 kilometres (2.5 mi) from Le Locle, where it has a cross-platform interchange with the standard gauge Neuchâtel–Le Locle-Col-des-Roches line of Swiss Federal Railways, to Les Brenets. The line was originally built by the Régional des Brenets and opened on 1 September 1890.
